replacements.old: The test checks EAP against a finite difference, and checks that the IG scores approximately add up to $m(\mathbf{1}) - m(\mathbf{0})$.
replacements.new: The tests independently recompute full-minus-one forward effects at several edges of your graph. A separate tiny CPU graph has four unequal signed causal effects and two zero-effect distractors; it checks every edge against analytic exact effects, endpoint EAP derivatives and edgewise integrated gradients. This rejects all-zero or permuted scores even when their shape or total looks plausible. The supplied graph also checks EAP against a finite difference and approximate IG completeness $m(\mathbf{1}) - m(\mathbf{0})$. Endpoint derivatives, path allocations and independent edge removals answer different questions on nonlinear graphs; agreement of totals alone is insufficient.

rationale: LC-8.8-01: document independent exact and edgewise analytic CPU oracle tests; no compiled/native model measurement implied.
